newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish 16-pct 2-yr fixed bond min price at 93.17.
newsitem.headline: Polish 16-pct 2-yr fixed bond min price at 93.17.

text.p: Poland sold 413 million zlotys of 16-percent two-year bonds after investors bid for 585 million zlotys worth, and set the minimum price at 93.17 and the average price at 93.36, the treasury said on Thursday.
The treasury also sold 52 million zlotys of 12-percent five-year bonds after investors bid for 179 million, and set the minimum price at 80.45 and the average price at 80.56.
The settlement date for the shorter bonds is November 5, 1996, and November 12 for the longer paper.
